caseName: Young v. United States Board of Parole
caseNameFull: YOUNG v. UNITED STATES BOARD OF PAROLE
attorneys: Appellant pro se., Solicitor General Marshall, Assistant Attorney General Vinson and Beatrice Rosenberg for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The appeal is dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for a writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
